purpose: Prospective held-out calibration of the L1 boundary and success judges.

design.reason_axes_are_separate: Some success rubrics include compliance constraints, so forcing every boundary-by-success quadrant would create logically invalid examples.
design.coverage: Every one of the 15 source items appears once on each axis in each target class.

protocol: Two annotators label their packets independently.
Disagreements are adjudicated without exposing author-seeded labels.
Human consensus labels are frozen before any LLM judge is run on this batch.
Only after the freeze are two cross-vendor judges evaluated against the same human gold labels.
interpretation_guardrails: These synthetic examples are judge-calibration cases, not model leaderboard results.
Author-seeded labels are construction targets, not human gold labels.
No judge-performance claim may be made until blind human consensus is frozen.
